shortDescription: Arthur Hayes said BTC has fallen below its previous local low. According to Odaily, he wrote on X that if the Nasdaq continues to decline, BTC’s next major support test could come near $50,000.

title: Arthur Hayes: BTC Breaks Below Previous Low, Next Key Support May Be Near $50,000
